## About this round

SCF #44 Build award (Integration track) to move Paycashless's SME settlement layer (virtual POS, invoicing, payouts, working capital) onto Stellar; serves 150+ merchants. Award listed in the SCF #44 round recap published 24 Jul 2026 (round closed for submissions 14 Jun 2026); Stellar Nigeria / Dealroom / Technext publicised the Nigerian winners on 19 Aug 2026. XLM-denominated award, USD value as stated by SCF.
